propositions: The metrics analyzer toolchain (lizard, scc, jscpd) must be explicitly named in bootstrap paths to prevent silent regression if motivation for including them changes.
Lizard is already pulled transitively by dev extra via pyproject.toml metrics dependency, but this must be hardened by naming metrics extra explicitly in Makefile install and install-unlocked.
Non-Python analyzers scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) require documented manual installation steps (brew install scc, npm install -g jscpd) since they cannot be provisioned via Python extras.
Bootstrap changes to Makefile install and install-unlocked must preserve existing uv-locked rationale comments rather than replacing them.
Absence of scc or jscpd should degrade gracefully to unavailable metrics rather than causing hard failures in rebar metrics output.
Documentation in docs/local-dev-env.md must mark scc and jscpd as optional and explain that their absence results in clean unavailable status.
